title: Einstein (1905), On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies
type: Original physics paper, English translation hosted by a university
scope: The physical relativity principle, inertial frames and explicit clock/measurement definitions. Does not establish a social transformation law or moral relativism.

title: Landauer and Dumais (1997), A Solution to Plato's Problem
scope: High-dimensional semantic models predate contemporary LLMs. The paper models language/knowledge tasks, not complete consciousness.

scope: Cooperation among human/machine agents, connecting multi-agent systems, game theory, social choice and alignment. Does not validate this book's institutions.
